changes: Removed duplicate app title bar and decorative login story; retained native Windows caption and system controls.
Compact neutral desktop navigation, footer status and grouped settings.
System/light/dark appearance with native titlebar theme and local persistence.
Node ordering by name, online state or measured latency; ordering does not change selection.
Node context menu, arrow-key focus, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+1..4 and F5; modal purchase retains its own keyboard handling.
Window size and maximised state saved on normal close/quit, with validation and small-screen fallback.
scope_limits: DOM interaction and native headless execution are checked; no graphical window or screenshot was opened.
Window appearance APIs and resizing use Wails/Windows runtime; physical DPI, native Snap and on-screen appearance need visual validation on a Windows session.
No transport algorithm changes. The earlier v0.6.4 ten-minute speed result is not a new v0.6.5 speed claim.
Closing the caption still hides to tray. Explicit exit disconnects and restores the proxy.
Absolute window coordinates are not restored, to avoid inaccessible windows after monitor changes.
